name: Vorlus Vilehoof
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Before I can teach you, you must show me your resolve.

The satyr Vorlus Vilehoof has found one of our remote moonwells, southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.  He now splashes within it, defiling its pure waters with his filth.

Find Vorlus at the moonwell and destroy him.  Bring me his horn as proof and I will begin your advanced training as a warrior.

The path to the moonwell is hidden well, adventurer, but stay focused and alert and you will find it.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Horn of Vorlus to Elanaria in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done, adventurer. It is good to know Vorlus is defeated and our moonwell cleansed, and it is good to see young warriors eager to keep our beloved Teldrassil free of corruption.

Now let us begin your training...
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the horn, adventurer? Is our moonwell free of the fiend Vorlus?
